title: Money That Lasts
subtitle: Saving, spending and paying less tax
summary: How much a portfolio can safely pay out, why the order of good and bad years matters more than their average, and how to move money between pre-tax, Roth, HSA and taxable accounts so that tax and income-tested costs take as little as the law allows. Live models run on US market history since 1871 and the 2026 federal tax rules, with branches on Washington, Portugal, equity pay and more. Education about how the rules work, not personal advice.
